setlist_extra.title: gd19870327.06.beat it on down the line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Touch Of Grey** (3 reviews): Garcia raised his fist, signaling his return from coma-land to the crowd; Garcia raised his mighty paw of power multiple times during the performance [18][21][26]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Brent's solo used spinning Leslie speakers, nearly blowing the audience's heads off [18]
- **Beat It On Down The Line** (1 review): Bobby performed a standout version, asking the audience how old they were [21]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): The band twanged the song to death, which blew the reviewer away [23]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): The performance was nostalgically pleasing but hardly memorable to the listener [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-03-27.140871.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 137 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1987-03-27.sbd.miller.95717.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 136 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: The matrix SBD is pretty hissy with lots of audience noise [4]
- **gd1987-03-27.163464.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 133 min [5]
- **gd87-03-27.nak.braverman.7343.sbefixed.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 129 min; rated 4.54/5 by 28 [13]. Said about its sound: The venue's vertical architecture gave the sound significant power; The recording has high levels, though the sound is otherwise nice [19][29]
- **gd1987-03-27.145672.ots.at835b.akg.d12e.blend.ackerman.noel.t-flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 130 min [14]

## Around the show

- Hartford combined with giggle juice resulted in happy feet for the crowd [14]
- This performance is one of the reviewer's favorites for that specific song [20]
- The band was more dynamic with higher emotional peaks than the previous evening [22]
- Combining the first set of 3/26/87 and second of 3/27/87 would be epic [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-03-27.140871.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [1]
- **gd1987-03-27.sbd.miller.95717.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette [4]
- **gd1987-03-27.163464.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME80 mics > Sony D5M [5]. Also: Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source supplied a 0:28 patch in the Drums section [5]
- **gd87-03-27.nak.braverman.7343.sbefixed.shnf**: source: Audience Master Cassette (Nakamichi 300 / Sony D5M) > Nakamichi BX-300 > CD > SHN [13]
- **gd1987-03-27.145672.ots.at835b.akg.d12e.blend.ackerman.noel.t-flac16**: taped by Ray Ackerman; transferred by Joe Noel; source: Ray Ackerman’s Master Audience Cassettes; Two x Audio Technica 835b + One x AKG D12e center fill > Realistic 32-1105A, 4 channel stereo mixer > Sony TCD5 (OTS) [14]. Also: Joe Noel edited and mastered the file; Ray provided the hi-res upgrade [14]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Volume 36: Hartford Civic Center, Hartford, CT 3/26/87 & 3/27/87 - Sealed 2020 US 4-CD set](https://us.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-36-hartford-civic-center-hartford-ct-3-26-87-and-3-27-87-sealed-us-4-cd-album-set-r2607319-866381) [31]
- Fan art by Jake May: [Grateful Dead Prep 3/26/87 and 3/27/87 Shows in Hartford for Archival 'Dave's Picks' Release](https://jambands.com/news/2020/10/15/grateful-dead-prep-3-36-87-and-3-37-87-shows-in-hartford-for-archival-daves-picks-release/) [32]
